Priya (Docs): Quick patch incoming: found 2 bad anchors in the Dedicated provisioning guide and one autoscale snippet that still uses legacy keys. I'll open a tiny PR to fix links, swap the YAML, and update the TS SDK example.
Phil (Infra): paste the trimmed YAML we should use for the handbook:
Phil (Infra): ```yaml
annotations:
  redwood.com/isolation: \"reserved-pool\"
scale_policies:
  - name: baseline
    min_replicas: 1
    max_replicas: 6
```
Nora (SDK): TS note: API changed from `createDedicatedPool()` -> `reserveCapacity()` which returns `{ poolId }`. Small snippet will show new call and returned id.
Omar (ML): content nit: quantization paragraph references an old model family. Replace with: "Use per-workload quant profiles; run a perf vs quality sweep before applying globally." One sentence.
Priya (Docs): plan: 1) fix anchors; 2) swap YAML (Phil's); 3) update TS snippet (Nora's); 4) add a one-line migration callout at top; 5) add two bullet eviction note: reserved = not preempted; shared = may be preempted. Will keep handbook example <30 lines and link to appendix. I'll push and ping reviewers.
ci-bot: docs-link-check passed on branch priya/guardrail-snippet-fix :white_check_mark:
Priya (Docs): Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
